title: AGENT-PROGRAM-003: deferred issue evidence and readiness queue
intent: Evidence and readiness increment only. Record deferred Agent Program findings as a disposition layer over the 002A incident census, with explicit deployment gates. Implements none of the queued capabilities, creates no Agent 002, adds no orchestration, and changes no production behavior. implementation_authorized is false for every item.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds the deferred-issue contract document, a ten-item machine-readable queue, a read-only queue validator plus tests, and trial row GA-TRIAL-0007. One item is READY_FOR_DECISION, one is BLOCKED on PR #341, two are PENDING_CENSUS_AMENDMENT, five record an ATTEMPTED/NOT_FOUND evidence-recovery pass. No queued capability is implemented.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The 002A incident census is the canonical incident evidence and is a closed review artifact carrying a terminal decision. It does not track what would have to become true before a deferred finding may be implemented. This increment is that missing readiness layer, and it references census incident ids rather than restating them so there is only one census authority.

files.intent: Canonical human-readable queue: purpose, authority boundary, state and evidence vocabularies, readiness rules, the ten items, and how a future Dev Order consumes one.
Machine-readable readiness queue. References 002A incident ids; not a second incident registry and not a runtime registry.
Read-only queue contract validation and summary. Stdlib only, no network, no Git invocation, no write path, cannot set authorization.
Deterministic DI-001..DI-015 queue-integrity and readiness tests, plus queue-level invariants.
Record real operational use GA-TRIAL-0007, the program's first blocked run, with both executions preserved. No historical row rewritten.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Documentation, a governance data artifact, and a read-only validator. No Grounding Agent code change, no Agent 002, no orchestration or dispatch, no production capability change, no cross-repo mutation. Every queue item carries implementation_authorized false, pinned by test.

no_backend_no_schema: No backend API, route, schema, persistence, workflow, or build change.
